claims.text: Grupo Boticário says its proprietary reseller-journey agent ecosystem has hundreds of agents, including more than 30 for the reseller journey.
Since November 2025, Grupo Boticário's agents cover 100% of appchat and WhatsApp Enterprise conversations and autonomously resolve up to 80% of operational requests.
Grupo Boticário's AI initially handles/qualifies 90% of direct-sales leads and hands a lead to human support when the lead signals intent to complete an order.
Grupo Boticário's frontline business teams own prompts and run daily A/B tests, and dedicated agents validate the responses of other agents.
Grupo Boticário's platform is proprietary, built on OpenAI technology, combining foundation models, business rules, and generative and predictive AI.
LangChain's production GTM agent triggers on Salesforce leads, researches the account, drafts outreach and account-intelligence reports, and presents a Slack draft with sources and reasoning.
LangChain's GTM agent requires explicit rep approval before anything is sent; the rep can send, edit or cancel in Slack.
LangChain's GTM agent has a later 48-hour SLA that auto-sends silver-lead drafts if no decision is made, an exception to the approval rule.
LangChain's GTM agent reports lead-to-qualified-opportunity conversion up 250% from December 2025 to March 2026, with 3x pipeline dollars.
LangChain's GTM agent follow-up rose 97% for lower-intent leads and 18% for higher-intent leads, and reps reclaimed 40 hours per month each (1,320 hours total).

LangChain's GTM agent is built on LangChain Deep Agents and LangSmith, using Salesforce, Gong, LinkedIn/web research, BigQuery and Exa, constrained parallel subagents, and PostgreSQL per-rep style memory.
LangChain's GTM agent quality control uses rule assertions on tool order and duplicates plus an LLM judge scoring tone, word count and formatting, with every send, edit and cancel traced.
LangChain's GTM agent avoids outreach after a recent support ticket or teammate contact because a poorly timed email could damage relationships.
Brevo's Dust-Supabase agents have executed more than 2,500 production actions since June 2025, across referral-customer finder, personalized email generation and personalized landing-page workflows.
Brevo reports email personalization time fell 80%, from 30+ minutes to minutes per prospect, and that self-serve agents handle 30%+ of internal RevOps requests.
Brevo's prompt rules require agents to reference only data present in Supabase to prevent fabricated customer names or statistics.
Brevo's personalized landing-page flow runs end-to-end with no human in the loop.
Brevo's workflows were built by RevOps on the general commercial Dust platform and Supabase via MCP, without backend services or engineering tickets.
Alan runs three sequential Dust agents that turn Modjo interview recordings into customer-story drafts, check brand voice, and translate/localize them.
Alan reports content production time fell from two days to a few hours (about 80% faster), with manual review bottlenecks eliminated.

Alan's Brand Voice Guardian agent checks every content piece against Alan's standards, and a Translation & Grammar Agent preserves voice across European languages; the source does not specify a human sign-off before publication.
Brillio's Paystream on the ADAM platform uses six purpose-built agents on its own production NetSuite AP function across six legal entities, releasing 80% of manual invoice-processing effort.

Brillio's AP system fails closed: no Vendor Bill is created under ambiguity, an Unprocessed queue records the fail reason, and ambiguous or failed validations plus credit-card/subcontractor invoices go to human review.
Brillio's AP system has a validation rulebase of 40+ country/policy rules and an operations console with monitoring and pause controls.

Genpact's AP deployment for an anonymized logistics provider processes nearly 3.5 million invoices annually using 21 pretrained prioritization agents plus domain-specific agents; touchless processing rose from 7% to up to 65%, extraction accuracy from 40% to 92%, and about $350m in duplicate invoices were identified.
